description: Object kinds a script can place (objects[].kind). Each kind lists its fields; at (position, metres), rotation (degrees), scale, hidden, parent (ride on another object: at becomes relative to it), part (with parent: ride on one of its named parts, e.g. a balance pan on the beam or a hat on "<critter>#head"; then at is measured from that part's pivot, the centre of a head, in the parent's own units, so it and the child's size are multiplied by the parent's size, while a child without part is placed in metres) and pivot ([x, y, z]: the point the object turns and grows about) apply to every kind. inherit: "size" (with parent, no part) scales a child's at and scale by the parent's size, so a mini scene on a story card shrinks with the card (default: a child is placed in metres). Any teaching object (or any other object) may use on: { "line": "<number_line id>", "value": 0.75 } instead of at to stand on a number line at that value.

fields.shape: shapes.json name (required); for thin boards, mats, signs and plates use plate (a 1 x 0.04 x 1 slab)
fields.face: true for eyes, rosy cheeks and a smile on the front
fields.feeling: starting feeling for a face (face: true)

number_block.description: A rounded toy block with its number on the front and back faces.

fields.size: type size, default 1: the cap height is about 1.41 x size, the x-height 0.98 x size, and descenders (g, j, p, q, y) reach 0.47 x size below the baseline (Andika; other fonts differ a little)
fields.lift: "descender": raise the text so its lowest point (a Q's tail, the loop of g, j, p, q, y) sits on at's y instead of hanging below the floor; absent: the text stands on the font baseline
fields.forms: school (default: single-storey a and g, as children learn to write) or book (two-storey a and g, as in reading books)
fields.colors: list of colors.json names, one per character (blend letters, rhyme endings); characters past the list use color
fields.split: start split after these character numbers ([2]: "ca ble"), as the split action leaves it
fields.splitGap: the gap of a starting split, default 0.35 x size

letter.description: Extruded 3D text, centred on x and standing on the font baseline: at is the baseline, so flat-bottomed letters touch it and g, j, p, q and y hang below it (letters, digits, short words).

fields.clip: starting clip, default the character's idle
fields.feeling: starting feeling (Robo shows it with his face)

character.description: A rigged glTF character that plays catalog clips.

fields.area: [width, depth] of the drop zone, default [8, 4]

confetti.description: Seeded confetti that falls when a burst action fires it.

fields.color: colors.json name, overrides the body colour
fields.feeling: starting feeling: happy (default), sad, surprised, angry, worried, sleepy, joyful
fields.recolor: { "<colour a part uses>": "<new colour>" } (colors.json names): rebuilds the parts drawn in one colour in another, e.g. { "leaf": "brown", "pink": "yellow" } for a wilted plant; the main colour too

critter.description: A toy animal that bobs, blinks and wags; targets <id>#head and named parts (tail) take rotation tweens; its eyes prop closes its eyes (sleep).

fields.color: colors.json name, overrides the main colour
fields.recolor: { "<colour a part uses>": "<new colour>" } (colors.json names): rebuilds the parts drawn in one colour in another, e.g. { "leaf": "brown", "pink": "yellow" } for a wilted plant; the main colour too

prop.description: A toy object built from parts (catalog/models.json and catalog/models/*.json). Named parts (a lid, a door, a plank) are targets <id>#<part> for turn, move, wiggle and spin.

bubbles.description: Soap bubbles that float up and pop (with soft pop sounds) when a burst action fires them.

stars.description: A backdrop of slowly twinkling stars (no flashing) for night scenes.

fields.minuteHand: false starts with the long hand hidden

clock.description: A teaching clock that stands on its rim and faces the camera; the clock move turns its hands to a time (the hour hand moves with the minutes).

fields.aim: [x, y, z] the spot it points at (world)
fields.beam: true draws a faint cone of light

lamp.description: A spotlight that casts real shadows (shadow puppets, a torch in the dark). Place it with at; point it with aim; show and hide fade it.

weather.description: Rain, snow, falling leaves or petals that keep falling while the object is shown (show to start, hide to stop).

group.description: An empty holder: give other objects parent: <this id> and move, turn or grow them all as one (a rocket made of parts, a tray of cookies).

fields.length: metres from the first to the last value, default 8
fields.step: a labelled tick every step, default 1
fields.minor: equal parts between labelled ticks, default 1 (4 for quarters)
fields.labels: "numbers" (default: labelled ticks), "fractions" (every tick, e.g. 1/4, 2/4, 3/4, 1), "none", or a list of strings (one per labelled tick, or one per tick)

number_line.description: A toy number line along x (at is its centre, on the floor): a rounded beam on two legs, 0.56 m high, with ticks hanging down its front and the numbers under them. Objects stand on it with on: { line, value } and leap along it; build pops the ticks in one by one, draw grows it from the left.

fields.shaded: parts shaded from the left at the start, default 0
fields.label: true shows "shaded/parts" over the bar (it follows shade)
fields.sizes: unequal parts: a share per part (left to right) adding up to 1, e.g. [0.5, 0.25, 0.25] for a not-fair split; default equal

fraction_bar.description: A bar standing up, facing the camera, cut into equal parts with gaps between them. Parts are targets <id>#p1 ... for move, turn, mark and highlight.

fields.shaded: slices shaded at the start (from 12 o'clock, clockwise), default 0
fields.label: true shows "shaded/parts" over the circle
fields.sizes: unequal slices: a share per slice (clockwise from 12 o'clock) adding up to 1; default equal

fraction_circle.description: A pie standing on its rim, facing the camera, cut into equal slices from 12 o'clock going clockwise. Slices are targets <id>#s1 ... for move (pull a slice out), turn, mark and highlight.

fields.item: dot (a ball, default), any shapes.json name, or a props model name
fields.trays: true puts a tray under each row (equal groups)

array.description: Rows and columns of equal things standing up like a pegboard, row 1 on top (at is the bottom centre). Items are targets <id>#i1 ... (row by row) for mark and highlight.

fields.upright: true stands it like a wall chart; otherwise it lies flat on the floor (row 1 at the back)
fields.labels: "numbers" writes 1..rows x cols in the cells, row by row (a hundred chart); default none

grid.description: Unit squares on a white board for area and perimeter. Cells are targets <id>#c1 ... (row by row) for mark and highlight; shade colours them, trace runs round the edge.

fields.color: default orange (alternate layers are a little lighter)
fields.box: true draws a clear box around them

cubes.description: Unit cubes stacked into a box shape for volume (at is the bottom centre). Cubes are targets <id>#c1 ... (bottom layer first) for mark and highlight; build order layers stacks them layer by layer.

fields.from: [x, y, z] start (relative to at, so world when at is left out) (required unless fromTarget)
fields.head: the to end: arrow (default), dot or none
fields.tail: the from end: none (default), arrow or dot. none/none is a line, dot/dot a segment, dot/arrow a ray, arrow/arrow a double arrow
fields.fromTarget: object id: the from end follows that object (the centre of its box; from becomes an offset in metres)
fields.toTarget: object id: the to end follows that object (to becomes an offset in metres)

pointer.description: A chunky 3D arrow (cause and effect, food chains, energy flow); draw grows it from start to tip. With head and tail it is also a line, ray or segment, and its ends can follow moving objects (a kite string, food-web arrows).

fields.point: [x, y, z] the spot it names (relative to at)
fields.target: or an object id (placed before it): the leader points at 0.6 of its height
fields.offset: [x, y, z] from the point to the card's centre, default [1.2, 1, 0]
fields.color: text, leader and dot colour, default ink

callout.description: A label on a card with a leader line and a dot at what it names (parts of a plant, a vertex); draw runs the leader out, then pops the card.

fields.arc: true (default) draws the arc between the rays (a square corner at 90)
fields.label: true (default) writes the degrees ("45°") outside the arc

angle.description: Two rays from a vertex (at; lift it off the floor) facing the camera: the first along +x, the second turned by degrees. open turns it wider or narrower.

fields.points: list of [x, y, z] (2-400) relative to at (required)
fields.smooth: true: a smooth curve through the points (waves, loops); default false: straight lines with sharp corners (zigzags)
fields.closed: true joins the last point back to the first
fields.pen: true or "pencil": a pencil at the tip while it is drawn; "dot": a glowing dot; default none

stroke.description: A line drawn as a round tube along points (prewriting strokes: straight, wavy, zigzag, loops; paths and tracing). draw reveals it from start to end, optionally with a pencil at the tip.

fields.points: list of [x, y, z] (2-400) relative to at (required)
fields.smooth: true: a smooth curve through the points
fields.closed: true: a loop (dots go round and round)
fields.color: dot colour at the start, default red
fields.changes: list of { at: 0-1 along the path, color }: dots turn that colour from there (blue to red at the lungs)
fields.track: true draws the path faintly under the dots

flow.description: Evenly spaced dots moving along a path for as long as it is shown (blood round the body, air in and out, energy along a food chain).

fields.numerator: whole number or up to 4 characters (required)
fields.denominator: whole number or up to 4 characters (required)
fields.whole: the whole number of a mixed number (1 in 1 3/4), optional
fields.size: type size, as a letter's: default 0.5
fields.depth: extrusion depth as a share of size, default 0.2

fraction_text.description: A stacked fraction (numerator over a bar over the denominator), with an optional whole number for mixed numbers. at is the baseline: give it the same y and size as the letters of an equation and its bar sits on the maths axis, level with + and =.

fields.columns: header strings, left to right, with "." for the decimal point column; default [hundreds, tens, ones, ., tenths, hundredths]
fields.digits: a string such as "35.2": placed right-aligned at the decimal point (no "." column: the ones are the last column)
fields.cell: column width and digit row height in metres, default 0.8
fields.color: frame and header colour, default blue
fields.zeroColor: placeholder zeros a shift adds, default orange

place_value_chart.description: An upright place value chart: header labels over digit cells, with a fixed decimal point. shift slides the digits by powers of ten; set puts new digits in.

fields.text: 1-300 characters, at most 6 lines when wrapped; \n starts a new line (required)
fields.size: font size in metres, default 0.2 (a line is 1.4 x size), 0.03-0.6
fields.bg: card colour, default white; "none" draws only the words (on a page or a card with its own backing)
fields.align: left (default) or center: each wrapped line centred (word cards, tiles)
fields.height: fixed card height in metres: the text is centred in it and shrinks (never grows) until it fits
fields.depth: card thickness in metres, default 0.06 (a chunky word tile ~0.15)
fields.pad: margin round the text as a share of the font size, default 0.7 (cards use 0.15 so big words keep their size)

text_card.description: A card with a short reading passage, word-wrapped to its width and drawn crisply; at is its bottom centre. emphasize highlights a phrase with a marker sweep.

fields.color: ring colour when full, default green (it drains through yellow to orange)
fields.fixed: true keeps the ring one colour

timer_ring.description: A countdown timer for challenges: a round face with a ring that drains clockwise, big 3-2-1 numbers at the end and a bounce when it rings. Usually hud: true (it then defaults to the top-right timer spot); starts hidden, and the timer action pops it in and out.

fields.style: train (default), checklist, stars, path, islands (island map: flags rise, the surprise island waits in mist), town (town map: windows light), gauges (dials swing to full) pencil (a page that writes one line per step) or rainbow (an arch whose bands paint in one per step, a sun as the surprise; up to 10 steps)
fields.labels: optional text per slot (stars, path, pencil, rainbow: up to 2 characters; train, gauges, islands, town: up to 7, longer words shrink to fit; checklist: up to 14)
fields.surprise: true adds a surprise slot at the end; a string is what it reveals (up to 2 characters)
fields.corner: top_left (default), top_right or top: where a HUD tracker goes when it has no at
fields.filled: steps already filled at the start, default 0

tracker.description: A progress tracker that fills as the lesson goes: a train whose cars fill, a checklist, a row of stars or a path, with an optional surprise slot at the end (a gift with a question mark) to tease early. Use hud: true; it fits the top-left band clear of captions and the YouTube corners. Filled with the progress action.

fields.icon: ear, hand, mouth, eye, question, star, check, heart, drop, sun, leaf, apple, music, home, moon or snow

badge.description: A round sticker badge with an icon or a short word, for screen-space pop-ins (usually hud: true). The keyword, call and hook actions make their own badges; place one yourself to show a fixed sign. Starts hidden: pop it in.

fields.style: card (default: a picture card with a rim, picture on top, word below), tile (chunky wooden word/letter tile), word (long cream word card), strip (sentence strip), quote (a quotation with a tag and a pin), name_tag
fields.text: 0-160 characters (a word, a letter, a sentence or a quotation)
fields.picture: a prop, critter or shape name drawn on the card, fitted to it
fields.pictureColor: colour for a shape picture (or a recolor of a prop's main colour)
fields.relief: how far the picture stands out, as a share of its depth: 0.4 (default, a raised picture) down to 0.05 (nearly flat, for cards stacked in a pile or pages)
fields.tag: up to 6 characters in a small corner label: a sentence number (S3), a paragraph (P2), a page (p.4)
fields.width: metres (default per style; tiles, words and strips grow with the text)
fields.rim: frame colour of card and name_tag
fields.size: scale of the whole card, default 1

card.description: A card built from a backing, a text_card and an optional picture model (runtime/composite.js). Pieces: <id>_back, <id>_text (emphasize it), <id>_pic, <id>_tag, <id>_rim, <id>_pin. Flip it with turn, glow with highlight, wiggle when wrong, slide with move, snap onto a board socket with reparent. Covers picture cards, word cards and tiles, letter tiles, quote cards, sentence strips, name tags.

fields.style: book (default: cream page with a spine), article (headline, rule, picture, caption, sidebar), script, scroll (rolled ends), letter
fields.title: headline or title
fields.lines: 1-12 strings (sentences, paragraphs or script lines), each its own piece <id>_l1..
fields.numbers: number each line (default true for book and article)
fields.picture: a prop, critter or shape in a framed box under the title
fields.caption: text under the picture
fields.sidebar: a boxed note at the bottom
fields.width: metres, default 3.4 (the height follows the content)
fields.size: font size of the lines, default 0.14

page.description: A large page of numbered sentences (runtime/composite.js): at is its bottom centre. Every line is a text_card <id>_l<n> (emphasize words in it, highlight it, move it toward the camera to lift it off the page) with its number <id>_n<n>; also <id>_title, <id>_pic, <id>_cap, <id>_side, <id>_paper. Covers story pages, article pages, script pages, poem scrolls and big books.

fields.layout: pins (labeled pins, two rows when more than 3), columns (T-chart, comparison chart), venn (two circles: labels[0], labels[1], optional labels[2] for both) or timeline
fields.labels: slot headings, 1-8 strings of up to 28 characters (venn 2-3)
fields.title: a title strip across the top
fields.easel: true (default) stands it on easel legs, 0.55 m up; false hangs it from at
fields.color: frame and easel colour, default wood_dark
fields.cardWidth: width of the cards that go in the sockets, default 0.9 (a size-1 card)

board.description: A board that cards pin onto (runtime/composite.js): at is the foot of the easel. Headings <id>_h<k>, pins <id>_pin<k>, and sockets <id>_s<slot>_<row>: groups scaled so a card fits; snap a card on with reparent { parent: "<id>_s2_1", to: [0, 0, 0] } (a wrong card: wiggle, then drop it). Covers the evidence board (who, what, where, when, why, how), T-charts, comparison charts, Venn boards and timelines.

fields.style: post (default: a board on a post), hanging (from two ropes, board 2.2 m up) or wall (board 1.2 m up, no post)
fields.text: 1-120 characters, word-wrapped and centred on the board
fields.post: post height for style post, default 1.2

sign.description: A wooden sign with its words laid out (runtime/composite2.js): at is its foot. Pieces <id>_board, <id>_text (emphasize, retext), <id>_post. Covers town signs, stall signs, cave and park signs, exhibit signs.

fields.words: 1-8 words (up to 12 characters each), one per car
fields.colors: car colours in order (default red, blue, green, ...)
fields.engine: false for cars only (default true: an engine in front)

word_train.description: A toy train whose cars each carry a word tile (runtime/composite2.js): the engine at at facing +x, the words reading left to right (car1 is the leftmost). Pieces <id>_engine, <id>_car<k>, riders <id>_w<k> (cards: retext, highlight, reparent them; move the whole train with move or path). Covers word trains, letter trains and sentence trains.

fields.spreads: 1-8 spreads: [{ left: { text, picture }, right: { text, picture } }]
fields.width: page width, default 1.6 (the open book is twice this)

book.description: A big open storybook standing on a stand (runtime/composite2.js), spine at at. turn_page turns the next leaf (<id>_leaf<k>) over to show the next spread; text on each page is a text_card (emphasize it), pictures are props, critters or shapes in low relief.
